---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a RayNmeaSimulator capability or enhancement
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Purpose
What vessel-simulation or developer-testing need would this address? Describe the current limitation or unfinished capability.

## Proposed behavior
What should RayNmeaSimulator do? Describe the user workflow, relevant defaults, and expected results. State whether the behavior should be optional.

## Integration and scope
Which existing areas are affected (for example, Vessel Setup, Generate, Viewer, Object Tree, instruments, navigation, or saved Layouts)? Identify applicable NMEA2000, NMEA0183, and/or Signal K output **only where relevant**; protocol parity is not assumed.

## Acceptance criteria
How can we verify that the feature works? Include expected behavior when unavailable, disabled, or stopped, and any compatibility requirements for saved settings and Layouts.

## Alternatives and supporting context
Related existing code, original design intent, screenshots, documentation, or alternatives considered. Link any related issues or engineering reports.

> RayNmeaSimulator is a best-effort engineering simulator. Proposed behavior should not imply certified navigation, hardware equivalence, or guaranteed physical accuracy.
